q.en: Why not compare word IDs as meanings?
q.zh: 为什么不能用词 ID 比较含义？

a.en: IDs only identify lookup entries. Renumbering the vocabulary changes IDs without changing the words.
a.zh: ID 只标识查表条目。重新编号会改 ID，却不改变词。

q.en: Why are equal dimensions insufficient?
q.zh: 为什么维度相同还不够？

a.en: Two lists can have the same length but encode unrelated meanings. Training must establish a correspondence.
a.zh: 两个列表可同样长却表示无关含义，需要训练建立对应。

q.en: Why does [3,4] become [0.6,0.8]?

a.en: Its length is √(9+16)=5. Dividing both entries by 5 gives those values.
a.zh: 长度为 √(9+16)=5，两项各除以 5 即得。

q.en: If A doubles in size, does its cosine score double?
q.zh: A 的数值加倍时，余弦分数也加倍吗？

a.en: No. Its length doubles too, so unit(A) and similarity stay unchanged.
a.zh: 不会。长度也加倍，因此 unit(A) 与相似度不变。

q.en: Why not set missing audio to zero?
q.zh: 为什么不把缺失音频设为零？

a.en: Zero would act like an actual low score. Missing evidence means no observation, not a negative observation.
a.zh: 零会像真实低分那样起作用。缺证据表示没有观察，不是反面观察。

q.en: Can late fusion check exact lip–sound timing?
q.zh: 晚期融合能检查精确唇音时序吗？

a.en: A single score per stream loses that detail. Temporal features or earlier interaction are needed.
a.zh: 每流一个分数会丢失这种细节，需要时间特征或更早交互。

q.en: Why cannot a transcript answer every sound question?
q.zh: 为什么转写不能回答所有声音问题？

a.en: It focuses on spoken words and may omit wind, bells or music.
a.zh: 它关注说出的词，可能忽略风、铃声、音乐。

q.en: How many samples represent four seconds at 16 kHz?
q.zh: 16 kHz 下四秒有多少采样点？

a.en: kHz means thousands per second, so 16000×4=64000 samples in one channel.
a.zh: kHz 表示每秒千次，所以单通道有 16000×4=64000 点。

q.en: Why compare in both directions?
q.zh: 为什么比较两个方向？

a.en: An image competes among texts, while a text competes among images. The alternatives can differ.
a.zh: 图像在多条文字中选伙伴，文字在多张图中选伙伴，竞争项可以不同。

q.en: Does a large softmax share mean universal certainty?
q.zh: 大的 softmax 份额意味着普遍确定吗？

a.en: No. It depends on candidate descriptions and temperature; changing the list changes the share.
a.zh: 不意味着。它依赖候选说明与温度，改变列表会改变份额。

q.en: Why let the question change the weights?
q.zh: 为什么让问题改变权重？

a.en: Different questions need different image evidence, so fixed mixing can lose relevant details.
a.zh: 不同问题需要不同图像证据，固定混合可能丢掉相关细节。

q.en: Why encode stored images once?
q.zh: 为什么库存图只编码一次？

a.en: Many queries can reuse their embeddings if image content, preprocessing and model version stay compatible.
a.zh: 只要图像内容、预处理和模型版本兼容，多次查询就能复用嵌入。

q.en: What does top three change?
q.zh: 取前三项会怎样？

a.en: Both relevant items appear, so Recall@3 becomes one for this query. More results also demand more inspection.
a.zh: 两个相关项都出现，此查询 Recall@3=1，但更多结果需要更多检查。

q.en: Can two systems have the same Hit@2 but different recall?
q.zh: 两个系统的 Hit@2 相同，召回率还能不同吗？

a.en: Yes. For a query with two relevant images, finding one or both gives a hit. Their fractional recalls are one half and one. The metric determines which difference you can see.
a.zh: 可以。一条查询有两张正确图片时，找到一张或两张都算命中，但比例召回率分别是 1/2 和 1。指标决定你能看到哪种差异。

q.en: Does choosing the more probable response ensure accuracy?
q.zh: 选择更高概率回答就能确保准确吗？

a.en: No. Here the wrong answer has higher probability; the visible object must decide correctness.
a.zh: 不能。本例错误回答概率更高，正确性要由可见物体决定。

q.en: Why are words alone insufficient?
q.zh: 为什么只有词还不够？

a.en: The same numbers can belong to different rows or columns; layout determines their relationships.
a.zh: 相同数字可能属于不同行列，布局决定它们的关系。

q.en: Why check the audio when the sentence sounds natural?
q.zh: 句子通顺时为什么还要听音频？

a.en: A fluent substitution can change the instruction while remaining grammatically valid.
a.zh: 流畅的替换仍可能改变指令，同时语法完全正常。

q.en: Can WER exceed one?
q.zh: WER 能超过一吗？

a.en: Yes. Many inserted words can make the edit count larger than the reference length.
a.zh: 可以。大量插入词可使编辑次数超过参考长度。

q.en: Why specify the sign of a shift?
q.zh: 为什么要规定偏移正负？

a.en: Different programs use opposite conventions. Here positive means audio is late, so correction moves it earlier.
a.zh: 不同程序可能使用相反约定。这里正数表示音频晚，校正时需提前。

q.en: Will one shift fix clock drift?
q.zh: 一个偏移能修复时钟漂移吗？

a.en: No. Check events over time; a changing delay requires more than a single constant correction.
a.zh: 不能。要随时间检查事件；变化延迟需要超出单个常量的校正。

q.en: Why not force a match for every event?
q.zh: 为什么不强制每个事件都匹配一帧？

a.en: The nearest frame can still be too far away. An explicit unmatched result preserves this uncertainty instead of hiding it inside a false association.
a.zh: 最近帧也可能仍然太远。明确返回未匹配，能保留不确定性，避免制造错误关联。

q.en: Would IoU one prove the action name correct?
q.zh: IoU 为一就证明动作名称正确吗？

a.en: No. Identical time boundaries can still be paired with an incorrect action description.
a.zh: 不能。相同时间边界仍可能搭配错误动作说明。

q.en: Why can output change when the visual encoder is frozen?
q.zh: 视觉编码器冻结时，输出为什么还会改变？

a.en: The connector can change how it uses the same fixed feature.
a.zh: 连接器可以改变使用同一固定特征的方式。

q.en: Does zero toy loss imply good image answers?
q.zh: 教学损失为零就能答好图像问题吗？

a.en: No. It only fits one invented scalar target. Language, perception and unseen tasks still need evaluation.
a.zh: 不能。它只拟合了一个虚构标量目标。语言、感知与新任务仍需评估。

q.en: Why retain page and region IDs?
q.zh: 为什么保留页码与区域 ID？

a.en: They let the reader inspect the specific evidence rather than trust a general source name.
a.zh: 它们让读者查看具体证据，而不只是相信笼统来源名。

q.en: Does a top-ranked chunk guarantee an answer?
q.zh: 首位内容块保证有答案吗？

a.en: No. It may mention the topic without containing the required fact, so the system needs an insufficient-evidence route.
a.zh: 不保证。它可能提到主题却不含所需事实，因此系统需要证据不足时的处理路线。

q.en: Why measure omissions too?
q.zh: 为什么也衡量遗漏？

a.en: A blank or extremely short answer can avoid many errors while failing to tell the user what matters.
a.zh: 空白或极短回答可以避免许多错误，却没告诉用户重要内容。

q.en: Does a missing reference word prove hallucination?
q.zh: 参考文字没有某词就证明幻觉吗？

a.en: No. A reference can omit a visible object. Inspect the image under a defined annotation protocol.
a.zh: 不能。参考可能漏掉可见物体。应按明确标注规范检查图像。

q.en: Why audit recall after making a shortlist?
q.zh: 创建短列表后为什么审查召回？

a.en: The answer stage cannot recover a relevant page that retrieval discarded.
a.zh: 回答阶段无法找回已被检索阶段丢弃的相关页。

q.en: Does fitting a token budget prove sufficient evidence?
q.zh: 符合词元预算就证明证据足够吗？

a.en: No. A small omitted diagram can contain the only answer. Budget and relevance are separate checks.
a.zh: 不能。被删小图可能包含唯一答案，预算和相关性需要分别检查。

print(f"text to image={column_loss:.4f}")

title.en: Evaluate retrieval with several relevant results per query
title.zh: 评估每条查询有多个正确结果的检索任务

intro.en: Mina searches an image collection with short text descriptions. One query has two valid pictures, another has one, and a third has no labeled match in the collection. A repeated image ID also appears in the ranked output. She removes duplicates, writes down which metric she means by recall, and reports unscored queries separately instead of hiding them.
intro.zh: 米娜用短文本搜索图像库。一条查询有两张正确图片，另一条只有一张，第三条在库中没有标注匹配。排序结果还出现了重复图片编号。她先去重，明确 recall 的具体定义，并单独报告不能评分的查询，而不是悄悄把它们隐藏。

questions.code:
from math import isclose

def retrieval_report(queries, k):
    if k <= 0:
        raise ValueError("positive k required")
    recalls, hits, reciprocal = [], [], []
    found_total = relevant_total = unscored = 0
    for ranked, relevant in queries:
        ranked = list(dict.fromkeys(ranked))  # Preserve the first occurrence.
        relevant = set(relevant)
        if not relevant:
            unscored += 1
            continue
        found = len(set(ranked[:k]) & relevant)
        recalls.append(found / len(relevant))
        hits.append(int(found > 0))
        first = next((i for i, item in enumerate(ranked, 1) if item in relevant), None)
        reciprocal.append(1 / first if first is not None else 0.0)
        found_total += found
        relevant_total += len(relevant)
    count = len(recalls)
    if not count:
        return {"scored": 0, "unscored": unscored, "macro_recall": None,
                "micro_recall": None, "hit_rate": None, "mrr": None}
    return {"scored": count, "unscored": unscored,
            "macro_recall": sum(recalls) / count,
            "micro_recall": found_total / relevant_total,
            "hit_rate": sum(hits) / count,
            "mrr": sum(reciprocal) / count}

queries = [(["a", "a", "x", "b"], {"a", "b"}),
           (["z", "c", "d"], {"c"}),
           (["x", "z"], set())]
report = retrieval_report(queries, 2)
assert isclose(report["macro_recall"], 0.75)
assert isclose(report["micro_recall"], 2 / 3)
assert report["hit_rate"] == 1.0 and report["mrr"] == 0.75
assert retrieval_report([([], {"a"})], 2)["mrr"] == 0.0
assert retrieval_report([([], set())], 2)["macro_recall"] is None
print(f"scored: {report['scored']}; unscored: {report['unscored']}")
for metric in ["macro_recall", "micro_recall", "hit_rate", "mrr"]:
    print(f"{metric}: {report[metric]:.6f}")
questions.output:
scored: 2; unscored: 1
macro_recall: 0.750000
micro_recall: 0.666667
hit_rate: 1.000000
mrr: 0.750000

en: Remove duplicate IDs before cutting off the top k. A repeated image must not occupy two result slots in this protocol.
For the first query, top two unique results are a and x. Only one of its two relevant images is found.
The second query finds its only relevant image at rank two. Its recall is one, but reciprocal rank is one half.
The query with no labeled relevant image is counted as unscored. It contributes to the coverage report, not to a division by zero.
zh: 本规则先去重，再截取前 k 个；同一图片不能占两个结果位置。
第一条查询的前两个不同结果是 a、x，只找到两张正确图片中的一张。
第二条在第 2 名找到唯一正确图片；召回率为 1，倒数排名为 1/2。
没有标注正确结果的查询计为未评分；单独报告覆盖情况，避免除以零。

title.en: Align events with timestamps, offsets and a tolerance
title.zh: 用时间戳、偏移和容差对齐事件

intro.en: Mina reviews a video with an audio event log. The video has uneven frame intervals. The audio clock reads 20 milliseconds ahead of the video clock. Multiplying time by a guessed frame rate gives wrong matches. She converts the audio timestamps to the video clock, finds the nearest observed frame, and leaves distant events unmatched.
intro.zh: 米娜核对视频与音频事件日志。视频帧间隔不完全相等，音频时钟比视频时钟快 20 毫秒。用时间乘猜测的帧率，会匹配错帧。她先把音频时间转换到视频时钟，再查找最近的实际帧，距离太远的事件保留为未匹配。

questions.code:
from bisect import bisect_left
from math import isclose

def nearest_frame(timestamps, event_time, offset, tolerance):
    if tolerance < 0 or not timestamps:
        raise ValueError("nonempty timestamps and nonnegative tolerance required")
    if any(a >= b for a, b in zip(timestamps, timestamps[1:])):
        raise ValueError("frame timestamps must be strictly increasing")
    target = event_time - offset  # audio_time = video_time + offset
    insertion = bisect_left(timestamps, target)
    candidates = [i for i in (insertion - 1, insertion) if 0 <= i < len(timestamps)]
    best = min(candidates, key=lambda i: (abs(timestamps[i] - target), i))
    error = abs(timestamps[best] - target)
    return (best, error) if error <= tolerance else None

video = [0.0, 0.041, 0.083, 0.126, 0.168]
events = [0.061, 0.104, 0.300]
matches = [nearest_frame(video, event, 0.020, 0.010) for event in events]
assert matches[0][0] == 1 and isclose(matches[0][1], 0.0, abs_tol=1e-12)
assert matches[1][0] == 2 and isclose(matches[1][1], 0.001)
assert matches[2] is None
assert nearest_frame([0.0, 2.0], 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)[0] == 0
for event, match in zip(events, matches):
    if match is None:
        print(f"audio {event:.3f}: unmatched")
    else:
        index, error = match
        print(f"audio {event:.3f}: frame {index}, error {error:.3f} s")
questions.output:
audio 0.061: frame 1, error 0.000 s
audio 0.104: frame 2, error 0.001 s
audio 0.300: unmatched

en: State the clock relation: audio time equals video time plus 0.020 seconds. Therefore subtract the offset.
Binary search finds the insertion point. Only the frames immediately before and after it can be nearest.
Choose the smaller distance, breaking exact ties toward the earlier frame.
Reject the last event: 0.300-0.020=0.280, which is 0.112 seconds from the final frame.
zh: 先明确时钟关系：音频时间=视频时间+0.020 秒，因此换算时要减去偏移。
二分查找定位插入点，只有紧邻它的前后两帧可能最近。
选择距离较小者；距离完全相同时选较早帧。

title.en: What mean pooling keeps and loses
title.zh: 平均池化保留了什么、丢掉了什么

prompt.en: Mia represents a short description by looking up each word's vector and averaging them. Write the exact output.
prompt.zh: Mia 用查表得到每个词的向量，再取平均来表示一段简短描述。请写出程序的准确输出。

questions.code:
table = {"red": [1.0, 0.0], "kite": [0.0, 2.0], "big": [2.0, 1.0]}

def pool(text):
    vectors = [table[word] for word in text.split()]
    return [sum(v[j] for v in vectors) / len(vectors) for j in range(2)]

print(pool("red kite"))
print(pool("kite red") == pool("red kite"))
print(pool("big red kite"))
print("blue" in table)

en: red kite: the vectors are [1, 0] and [0, 2]. First entry (1 + 0) / 2 = 0.5, second entry (0 + 2) / 2 = 1.0, so [0.5, 1.0].
kite red adds the same two vectors in the other order. Sums do not depend on order, so the pooled vectors are equal and the comparison prints True. Mean pooling has lost word order.
big red kite: first entry (2 + 1 + 0) / 3 = 1.0, second entry (1 + 0 + 2) / 3 = 1.0, so [1.0, 1.0].
blue is not a key of the table, so the test prints False. pool("blue kite") would raise a KeyError: a real system needs an unknown-token or subword rule.
zh: kite red 以相反的顺序加上同样的两个向量。求和与顺序无关，所以池化结果相等，比较打印 True。平均池化丢掉了词序。
blue 不是表中的键，所以这一行打印 False。pool("blue kite") 会抛出 KeyError：真实系统需要「未知词元」或子词规则。

title.en: What a token ID means
title.zh: 词元 ID 代表什么

prompt.en: Leon's tokenizer gives "kite" the ID 812 and "red" the ID 4. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Leon 的分词器给「kite」分配的 ID 是 812，给「red」分配的 ID 是 4。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The IDs are lookup addresses. The embedding row that each ID selects, which training adjusts, carries the useful numbers.
text.zh: ID 只是查表用的地址。真正承载有用数值的，是每个 ID 选中的那一行嵌入，而训练会调整这些嵌入。

why.en: Right. An ID says which row of the embedding table to read. Its size has no meaning.
why.zh: 正确。ID 只说明读取嵌入表的哪一行，它的大小没有任何含义。

text.en: kite carries about 200 times more meaning than red, because 812 / 4 = 203.
text.zh: kite 的含义大约是 red 的 200 倍，因为 812 / 4 = 203。

why.en: Wrong. ID 812 is not "more" than ID 4 in any sense; the numbers are like seat numbers.
why.zh: 错误。ID 812 在任何意义上都不比 ID 4「更多」；这些数字就像座位号。

text.en: The average of the IDs, (812 + 4) / 2 = 408, is a sensible vector for "red kite".
text.zh: 两个 ID 的平均值 (812 + 4) / 2 = 408 可以合理地表示「red kite」。

why.en: Wrong. Averaging addresses gives the address of an unrelated token. Average the embedding vectors instead.
why.zh: 错误。对地址取平均，得到的是一个毫不相关的词元的地址。应该对嵌入向量取平均。

text.en: Tokens with neighbouring IDs, such as 811 and 812, must have similar meanings.
text.zh: ID 相邻的词元，例如 811 和 812，含义一定相近。

why.en: Wrong. The tokenizer's numbering does not follow meaning. Similarity comes from the learned vectors.
why.zh: 错误。分词器的编号并不按含义排列。相似性来自学到的向量。

title.en: Cosine similarity of an image and a description
title.zh: 图像与描述的余弦相似度

prompt.en: An aligned image encoder returns a = (1, 2, 2) for a photo. The text encoder returns b = (0, 3, 4) for one description. What is their cosine similarity? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 一个已对齐的图像编码器为一张照片返回 a = (1, 2, 2)，文本编码器为一段描述返回 b = (0, 3, 4)。它们的余弦相似度是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Lengths: ‖a‖ = √(1 + 4 + 4) = 3 and ‖b‖ = √(0 + 9 + 16) = 5.

Unit vectors: a / 3 = (0.333, 0.667, 0.667) and b / 5 = (0, 0.6, 0.8).

Similarity = 0.333 × 0 + 0.667 × 0.6 + 0.667 × 0.8 = 0.4 + 0.533 = 0.933, which is 14 / 15 exactly (the dot product 0 + 6 + 8 = 14 divided by 3 × 5).

The score ranks this description highly for the photo. It is not a 93% probability that the description is correct; someone still has to check that the photo shows what the words say.

questions.verify_code:
import math
a, b = (1, 2, 2), (0, 3, 4)
dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
na, nb = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a)), math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in b))
print(dot, na, nb)
print(round(dot / (na * nb), 4))

title.en: Same length is not the same space
title.zh: 长度相同不等于同一空间

prompt.en: Iris has an image encoder and a text encoder that were trained separately, on unrelated tasks. Both happen to output 512 numbers. She computes the cosine similarity between a photo's vector and a caption's vector and gets 0.71. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Iris 有一个图像编码器和一个文本编码器，二者在互不相关的任务上分别训练。它们恰好都输出 512 个数。她计算一张照片的向量与一条说明文字的向量之间的余弦相似度，得到 0.71。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The score means little: nothing made coordinate j of the image vector describe the same thing as coordinate j of the text vector. The encoders must first be trained to align, for example on matched image–text pairs.
text.zh: 这个分数几乎没有意义：没有任何机制让图像向量的第 j 个坐标与文本向量的第 j 个坐标描述同一件事。必须先训练两个编码器使它们对齐，例如使用配对的图像–文本数据。

why.en: Right. Alignment is learned. Equal length is a requirement for the arithmetic, not evidence of compatible meaning.
why.zh: 正确。对齐是学出来的。长度相同只是进行运算的前提，并不说明含义相互兼容。

text.en: Because both vectors have 512 entries, they live in the same space, so 0.71 is a valid match score.
text.zh: 因为两个向量都有 512 个元素，它们处在同一个空间中，所以 0.71 是有效的匹配分数。

why.en: Wrong. Matching list lengths is not enough; the coordinates must acquire compatible meanings through training.
why.zh: 错误。列表长度相同还不够；坐标必须通过训练获得相互兼容的含义。

text.en: Normalising both vectors to length 1 makes them aligned.
text.zh: 把两个向量都归一化到长度 1，就能让它们对齐。

why.en: Wrong. Normalising removes overall size only. It cannot give unrelated coordinates a shared meaning.
why.zh: 错误。归一化只去掉整体大小，无法让毫不相关的坐标获得共同的含义。

text.en: 0.71 means the caption is about 71% likely to be correct.
text.zh: 0.71 表示说明文字大约有 71% 的可能是正确的。

why.en: Wrong. Cosine similarity is not a probability, even for aligned encoders, and here the encoders are not aligned at all.
why.zh: 错误。即使编码器已经对齐，余弦相似度也不是概率；何况这里的编码器根本没有对齐。

title.en: Late fusion with a missing modality
title.zh: 缺少一种模态时的后期融合

prompt.en: Noah's late-fusion system combines three scores with weights image 0.6, audio 0.3 and text 0.1. For one clip the image score is 0.7 and the text score is 0.2, but the audio is missing because the microphone failed. He renormalises the weights over the available modalities. What is the combined score? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: Noah 的后期融合系统用权重 图像 0.6、音频 0.3、文本 0.1 组合三个分数。某个片段的图像分数是 0.7，文本分数是 0.2，但由于麦克风故障，音频缺失。他在可用的模态上重新归一化权重。组合后的分数是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Step 1: available weights are image 0.6 and text 0.1, total 0.7.

Step 2: weighted sum = 0.6 × 0.7 + 0.1 × 0.2 = 0.42 + 0.02 = 0.44.

Step 3: renormalise: 0.44 / 0.7 ≈ 0.629. (Equivalently the weights become 6/7 and 1/7.)

If the missing audio were treated as a score of 0, the result would be 0.44: the microphone fault would quietly count as evidence against the label. Keep the separate scores too, because the image and text disagree here and a person may want to see that.
solution.zh:
第 1 步：可用的权重是图像 0.6 和文本 0.1，合计 0.7。

第 2 步：加权和 = 0.6 × 0.7 + 0.1 × 0.2 = 0.42 + 0.02 = 0.44。

第 3 步：重新归一化：0.44 / 0.7 ≈ 0.629。（相当于权重变成 6/7 和 1/7。）

如果把缺失的音频当作分数 0，结果会是 0.44：麦克风故障就会悄悄地被当作否定该标签的证据。也要保留各自的分数，因为这里图像和文本的结论不一致，人可能需要看到这一点。

title.en: Choose a fusion design for two tasks
title.zh: 为两个任务选择融合方式

prompt.en:
Iris's nature club records short clips with video and audio. They want two systems:

Task 1: "Is a bird present in this clip?" About 30% of clips have no audio because of microphone faults. They already have a reasonable image classifier and a separate audio classifier.
Task 2: "Did the bird open its beak at the same moment as the chirp?"

For each task, choose early (or intermediate) fusion or late fusion and justify it. Say how missing audio should be handled, and how any weights or thresholds should be chosen.
prompt.zh:
Iris 的自然社录制了带视频和音频的短片段。他们想要两个系统：

任务 1：「这个片段里有鸟吗？」约 30% 的片段因为麦克风故障没有音频。他们已经有一个不错的图像分类器和一个单独的音频分类器。
任务 2：「鸟张开嘴的时刻是否与鸣叫同时发生？」

请为每个任务选择早期（或中间层）融合还是后期融合，并说明理由。说明应如何处理缺失的音频，以及任何权重或阈值应如何选择。

solution.en:
Task 1: late fusion. Each modality gives independent evidence about presence, and the existing classifiers can be reused. Combine their scores with a weighted average whose weight α is chosen on validation clips. When audio is missing, renormalise over the available modality (use the image score alone) instead of treating missing audio as 0, which would count as evidence of absence. Keep the two scores so that disagreements can be reviewed, and check that the scores are on comparable scales.

Task 2: early or intermediate fusion, for example time-aligned features from both streams, or cross-attention from audio steps to video frames. The question is about timing between the modalities, which two clip-level scores cannot answer. It needs synchronised training examples with labelled timing, and a sync check before use. A clip without audio cannot answer the question at all, so the system should report "cannot tell" for it rather than guess.

For both: choose weights, thresholds and fusion settings on validation clips, never on the final test clips.
solution.zh:
任务 1：后期融合。每种模态都能独立提供「有没有鸟」的证据，而且现有的分类器可以直接复用。用加权平均组合两者的分数，权重 α 在验证片段上选择。音频缺失时，在可用的模态上重新归一化（只用图像分数），而不是把缺失的音频当作 0，否则就等于把它当成「没有鸟」的证据。保留两个分数，以便复查两者不一致的情况，并检查两个分数的尺度是否可比。

任务 2：早期或中间层融合，例如使用两路信号按时间对齐的特征，或者让音频时间步通过交叉注意力读取视频帧。这个问题关心的是两种模态之间的时间关系，两个片段级别的分数无法回答。它需要带有时间标注的同步训练样本，并在使用前做同步检查。没有音频的片段根本无法回答这个问题，所以系统应对它报告「无法判断」，而不是去猜。

两个任务都应在验证片段上选择权重、阈值和融合设置，绝不能在最终测试片段上选择。

text.en: Chooses late fusion for task 1 with a reason (independent evidence, reuse of existing classifiers).
text.zh: 为任务 1 选择后期融合并给出理由（证据相互独立、可复用现有分类器）。

text.en: Handles missing audio in task 1 by renormalising over available modalities, not by using 0.
text.zh: 任务 1 中通过在可用模态上重新归一化来处理缺失音频，而不是使用 0。

text.en: Chooses early or intermediate fusion (or cross-attention) for task 2 because it needs timing between the streams.
text.zh: 为任务 2 选择早期或中间层融合（或交叉注意力），因为它需要两路信号之间的时间关系。

text.en: Notes that task 2 needs synchronised, aligned examples and that clips without audio should get "cannot tell".
text.zh: 指出任务 2 需要同步对齐的样本，没有音频的片段应输出「无法判断」。

text.en: Chooses weights and thresholds on validation data (not test), and keeps separate scores for review.
text.zh: 在验证数据上（而不是测试数据上）选择权重和阈值，并保留各自的分数以便复查。

mistakes.en: Filling missing audio with a zero score, so the fault counts as evidence against a bird.
mistakes.zh: 用零分填补缺失的音频，使故障被当成「没有鸟」的证据。

mistakes.en: Answering task 2 by averaging an image score and an audio score for the whole clip.
mistakes.zh: 用整个片段的图像分数和音频分数取平均来回答任务 2。

mistakes.en: Tuning the fusion weight on the clips used for the final report.
mistakes.zh: 在用于最终报告的片段上调整融合权重。

title.en: Relabelling a sample rate
title.zh: 只改采样率标签的后果

prompt.en: Emma has a 3-second mono recording sampled at 44,100 samples per second. A script changes the file's sample-rate label to 22,050 without resampling the samples. What duration, in seconds, will a player now report?
prompt.zh: Emma 有一段 3 秒的单声道录音，采样率为每秒 44,100 个样本。某个脚本把文件的采样率标签改成了 22,050，却没有对样本做重采样。播放器现在会报告多长的时长（秒）？

solution.en:
Step 1: sample count = 44,100 × 3 = 132,300 samples. Relabelling does not change this count.

Step 2: reported duration = sample count / labelled rate = 132,300 / 22,050 = 6 seconds.

The recording now claims to be twice as long, and every sound plays at half speed and an octave lower. Proper resampling to 16,000 samples per second would instead produce 16,000 × 3 = 48,000 new samples and keep the duration at 3 seconds. Any timestamp or audio–text match computed from the relabelled file would be wrong by a factor of two.
solution.zh:
第 1 步：样本数 = 44,100 × 3 = 132,300 个。改标签不会改变这个数。

第 2 步：报告的时长 = 样本数 / 标签上的采样率 = 132,300 / 22,050 = 6 秒。

录音现在自称长了一倍，每个声音都以一半的速度、低一个八度播放。正确地重采样到每秒 16,000 个样本，会得到 16,000 × 3 = 48,000 个新样本，时长仍保持 3 秒。从改了标签的文件计算出的任何时间戳或音频–文本匹配，都会差两倍。

questions.verify_code:
duration, rate, wrong_rate = 3, 44100, 22050
count = duration * rate
print(count, 16000 * duration)
print(count / wrong_rate)

title.en: What a smaller temperature does
title.zh: 更小的温度会带来什么

prompt.en: In a CLIP-style batch, one image's cosine similarities to three captions are [0.6, 0.4, 0.1], and the first caption is its true partner. Jack lowers the temperature from τ = 1 to τ = 0.1 before the softmax. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: 在一个 CLIP 风格的批次中，一张图像与三条说明文字的余弦相似度是 [0.6, 0.4, 0.1]，第一条说明文字是它的真正配对。Jack 在 softmax 之前把温度从 τ = 1 降到 τ = 0.1。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: The true partner's share rises from about 0.41 to about 0.88, so its loss falls from about 0.89 to about 0.13. Temperature changes how strongly score gaps count.
text.zh: 真正配对所占的份额从约 0.41 升到约 0.88，所以它的损失从约 0.89 降到约 0.13。温度改变的是分数差距的影响力度。

why.en: Right. Dividing by 0.1 turns [0.6, 0.4, 0.1] into [6, 4, 1], so the gaps are ten times larger and softmax concentrates on the highest score.
why.zh: 正确。除以 0.1 把 [0.6, 0.4, 0.1] 变成 [6, 4, 1]，差距扩大了十倍，softmax 就更集中在最高分上。

text.en: Nothing changes, because softmax ignores a change applied to every score.
text.zh: 什么都不会变，因为 softmax 不受施加在所有分数上的变化影响。

why.en: Wrong. Softmax ignores adding the same number to every score, not multiplying every score by 10.
why.zh: 错误。softmax 不受「给每个分数加上同一个数」的影响，但「把每个分数乘以 10」就不同了。

text.en: The true partner's share falls, because dividing by a small number shrinks the scores.
text.zh: 真正配对所占的份额下降，因为除以一个小数会让分数变小。

why.en: Wrong. Dividing by 0.1 multiplies the scores by 10, which enlarges them and their gaps.
why.zh: 错误。除以 0.1 等于把分数乘以 10，分数和它们的差距都会变大。

text.en: The cosine similarities themselves change, because temperature is applied inside the encoders.
text.zh: 余弦相似度本身会改变，因为温度作用在编码器内部。

why.en: Wrong. The encoders' outputs and their cosines stay the same; temperature only rescales the scores before the softmax.
why.zh: 错误。编码器的输出和余弦值都不变；温度只在 softmax 之前缩放分数。

questions.verify_code:
import math
sims = [0.6, 0.4, 0.1]
for t in (1, 0.1):
    e = [math.exp(s / t) for s in sims]
    p = e[0] / sum(e)
    print(t, round(p, 4), round(-math.log(p), 4))

title.en: A two-pair contrastive loss in both directions
title.zh: 双向计算两对样本的对比损失

prompt.en:
Mia's batch has two image–text pairs. The cosine similarities are (rows are images, columns are texts, the true pairs are on the diagonal):

[[0.9, 0.3],
 [0.2, 0.6]]

The temperature is τ = 0.5. Compute the image→text loss (average over rows), the text→image loss (average over columns), and the CLIP loss, which averages the two directions. Use −ln of the correct partner's softmax share. Give the CLIP loss to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Mia 的批次中有两对图像–文本。余弦相似度如下（行是图像，列是文本，真正的配对在对角线上）：

[[0.9, 0.3],
 [0.2, 0.6]]

温度 τ = 0.5。请计算图像→文本损失（对各行取平均）、文本→图像损失（对各列取平均），以及把两个方向取平均得到的 CLIP 损失。每个查询的损失用正确配对 softmax 份额的 −ln。CLIP 损失保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Step 1: scale by 1/τ = 2: [[1.8, 0.6], [0.4, 1.2]].

With two candidates, −ln(share) = ln(1 + exp(−gap)), where gap = correct score − other score.

Step 2: rows (image→text).
Row 1: gap 1.8 − 0.6 = 1.2, loss ln(1 + e^−1.2) = ln 1.3012 ≈ 0.2633.
Row 2: gap 1.2 − 0.4 = 0.8, loss ln(1 + e^−0.8) = ln 1.4493 ≈ 0.3711.
Image→text = (0.2633 + 0.3711) / 2 ≈ 0.3172.

Step 3: columns (text→image).
Column 1: scores [1.8, 0.4], gap 1.4, loss ln(1 + e^−1.4) = ln 1.2466 ≈ 0.2204.
Column 2: scores [0.6, 1.2], gap 0.6, loss ln(1 + e^−0.6) = ln 1.5488 ≈ 0.4375.
Text→image = (0.2204 + 0.4375) / 2 ≈ 0.3290.

Step 4: CLIP loss = (0.3172 + 0.3290) / 2 ≈ 0.323.

The two directions differ because a column's competitors are not the same numbers as a row's. The weakest link is text 2 versus image 1 (0.3 against 0.6), which gives the largest single loss.

questions.verify_code:
import math
sim = [[0.9, 0.3], [0.2, 0.6]]
s = [[x / 0.5 for x in row] for row in sim]
def loss(scores, i):
    e = [math.exp(v - max(scores)) for v in scores]
    return -math.log(e[i] / sum(e))
rows = [loss(s[i], i) for i in range(2)]
cols = [loss([s[0][j], s[1][j]], j) for j in range(2)]
print([round(x, 4) for x in rows], [round(x, 4) for x in cols], round(sum(rows) / 2, 4), round(sum(cols) / 2, 4))
print(round((sum(rows) / 2 + sum(cols) / 2) / 2, 4))

title.en: A question mixes three image regions
title.zh: 一个问题混合三个图像区域

prompt.en:
A question token in Leon's model has query q = (2, 0). Three image regions supply keys and values:

region 1: key (1, 0), value (6, 0)
region 2: key (0, 1), value (0, 6)
region 3: key (1, 1), value (3, 3)

Use scores q·k / √2, a softmax over the three regions, and output = Σ weight × value. What is the first coordinate of the output? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Leon 模型中一个问题词元的查询是 q = (2, 0)。三个图像区域提供键和值：

区域 1：键 (1, 0)，值 (6, 0)
区域 2：键 (0, 1)，值 (0, 6)
区域 3：键 (1, 1)，值 (3, 3)

使用分数 q·k / √2，在三个区域上做 softmax，输出 = Σ 权重 × 值。输出的第一个坐标是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Step 1: scores. q·k₁ = 2, q·k₂ = 0, q·k₃ = 2. Divided by √2 ≈ 1.4142: [1.4142, 0, 1.4142].

Step 2: exponentiate: e^1.4142 ≈ 4.1133, e^0 = 1, e^1.4142 ≈ 4.1133. Sum ≈ 9.2265.
Weights ≈ [0.4458, 0.1084, 0.4458].

Step 3: output.
First coordinate: 0.4458 × 6 + 0.1084 × 0 + 0.4458 × 3 = 2.6748 + 1.3374 ≈ 4.012.
Second coordinate: 0.4458 × 0 + 0.1084 × 6 + 0.4458 × 3 ≈ 0.6504 + 1.3374 ≈ 1.988.

The output (4.012, 1.988) is a blend, not a copy of one region: regions 1 and 3 tie for the highest weight, and region 2 still contributes a little. A different question (a different q) would mix the same values differently. The weights alone do not prove that the final answer is right.

questions.verify_code:
import math
q = (2, 0)
keys = [(1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1)]
values = [(6, 0), (0, 6), (3, 3)]
s = [sum(a * b for a, b in zip(q, k)) / math.sqrt(2) for k in keys]
e = [math.exp(x) for x in s]
w = [x / sum(e) for x in e]
out = [sum(wi * v[j] for wi, v in zip(w, values)) for j in range(2)]
print([round(x, 4) for x in s], round(sum(e), 4), [round(x, 4) for x in w], [round(x, 4) for x in out])
print(round(out[0], 4))

title.en: Recall@3 for an image search
title.zh: 图像检索的 Recall@3

prompt.en:
Emma's search index stores unit image vectors. The unit query vector is [0.6, 0.8]. The images are:

P = [1, 0], Q = [0.8, 0.6], R = [0, 1], S = [0.6, 0.8], U = [0.28, 0.96]

Checked relevance: Q, R and U are relevant; P and S are not. Rank by dot product. What is Recall@3 (relevant items in the top 3 divided by all relevant items)? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Emma 的检索索引存储的是单位长度的图像向量。单位查询向量是 [0.6, 0.8]。图像如下：

P = [1, 0]，Q = [0.8, 0.6]，R = [0, 1]，S = [0.6, 0.8]，U = [0.28, 0.96]

经核对的相关性：Q、R、U 相关；P 和 S 不相关。按点积排序。Recall@3（前 3 名中的相关项数除以全部相关项数）是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Scores (dot products with [0.6, 0.8]):
P: 0.6. Q: 0.48 + 0.48 = 0.96. R: 0.8. S: 0.36 + 0.64 = 1.00. U: 0.168 + 0.768 = 0.936.

Ranking: S (1.00), Q (0.96), U (0.936), R (0.80), P (0.60).

Top 3 = S, Q, U. Relevant among them: Q and U, so 2. All relevant items: 3.
Recall@3 = 2 / 3 ≈ 0.667.

The top result S has a perfect score of 1.00 but is not relevant: a high similarity is not the same as the right object. R, which is relevant, sits just outside the shortlist; a reranker that only sees the top 3 can never recover it. A hit-rate convention ("at least one relevant item in the top 3") would give 1.0 here, so state which definition you use.
solution.zh:
分数（与 [0.6, 0.8] 的点积）：
P：0.6。Q：0.48 + 0.48 = 0.96。R：0.8。S：0.36 + 0.64 = 1.00。U：0.168 + 0.768 = 0.936。

排序：S（1.00）、Q（0.96）、U（0.936）、R（0.80）、P（0.60）。

前 3 名 = S、Q、U。其中相关的有 Q 和 U，共 2 个。全部相关项：3 个。
Recall@3 = 2 / 3 ≈ 0.667。

排名第一的 S 得到满分 1.00，却并不相关：相似度高并不等于找对了物体。相关的 R 恰好落在候选名单之外；只看前 3 名的重排器永远找不回它。如果按「命中率」约定（前 3 名中至少有一个相关项），这里会得到 1.0，所以要说明采用的是哪种定义。

title.en: Mean loss of a checked answer
title.zh: 核对答案的平均损失

prompt.en:
Under teacher forcing, Noah's captioning model assigns these probabilities to the four tokens of the checked answer (the last one is the ending token):

0.6, 0.25, 0.8, 0.95

What is the mean per-token loss −(ln p₁ + ln p₂ + ln p₃ + ln p₄) / 4? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
在教师强制下，Noah 的图像描述模型给核对答案的四个词元分配了以下概率（最后一个是结束词元）：

0.6、0.25、0.8、0.95

每个词元的平均损失 −(ln p₁ + ln p₂ + ln p₃ + ln p₄) / 4 是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Natural logs: ln 0.6 ≈ −0.5108, ln 0.25 ≈ −1.3863, ln 0.8 ≈ −0.2231, ln 0.95 ≈ −0.0513.

Sum ≈ −2.1716. Negate and divide by 4: 2.1716 / 4 ≈ 0.543.

The whole response has probability 0.6 × 0.25 × 0.8 × 0.95 = 0.114, and −ln 0.114 ≈ 2.1716 is the summed loss. The second token, with probability 0.25, contributes the most. A low loss says the model expects these words; whether the words are true of the image must be checked against the image.
solution.zh:
自然对数：ln 0.6 ≈ −0.5108，ln 0.25 ≈ −1.3863，ln 0.8 ≈ −0.2231，ln 0.95 ≈ −0.0513。

总和 ≈ −2.1716。取相反数再除以 4：2.1716 / 4 ≈ 0.543。

整个回答的概率是 0.6 × 0.25 × 0.8 × 0.95 = 0.114，而 −ln 0.114 ≈ 2.1716 就是总损失。概率为 0.25 的第二个词元贡献最大。损失低只说明模型预料到了这些词；这些词对图像来说是否属实，必须对照图像检查。

questions.verify_code:
import math
p = [0.6, 0.25, 0.8, 0.95]
logs = [math.log(x) for x in p]
print([round(x, 4) for x in logs], round(sum(logs), 4), round(math.prod(p), 4))
print(round(-sum(logs) / len(p), 4))

title.en: Group OCR words into rows
title.zh: 把 OCR 词语分组成行

prompt.en: Jack has OCR words with boxes (left, top, right, bottom) in pixels on a 400-pixel-wide page. The function selects words whose vertical centre is within 6 pixels of a target row, then reads them from left to right. Write the exact output.
prompt.zh: Jack 有一页宽 400 像素的扫描件，OCR 给出了每个词及其边界框（左、上、右、下，单位为像素）。函数选出竖直中心与目标行相差不超过 6 像素的词，再按从左到右的顺序读出。请写出程序的准确输出。

questions.code:
words = [("Room 8", (300, 82, 360, 98)), ("Friday", (40, 40, 110, 60)),
         ("Room 3", (300, 44, 360, 58)), ("Monday", (40, 84, 120, 100))]
page_width = 400

def row(target_y, tolerance=6):
    picked = [(box[0], text) for text, box in words
              if abs((box[1] + box[3]) / 2 - target_y) <= tolerance]
    return [text for left, text in sorted(picked)]

print(row(50))
print(row(90))
print(round(1000 * 300 / page_width))
questions.output:
['Friday', 'Room 3']
['Monday', 'Room 8']
750

en: row(50) keeps Friday (distance 0) and Room 3 (distance 1). Sorting by left edge puts Friday (40) before Room 3 (300): ['Friday', 'Room 3'].
row(90) keeps Room 8 (distance 0) and Monday (distance 2). Sorting by left edge gives ['Monday', 'Room 8'], even though Room 8 came first in the OCR list.
zh: row(50) 保留 Friday（距离 0）和 Room 3（距离 1）。按左边界排序，Friday（40）在 Room 3（300）之前：['Friday', 'Room 3']。
row(90) 保留 Room 8（距离 0）和 Monday（距离 2）。按左边界排序得到 ['Monday', 'Room 8']，尽管在 OCR 列表里 Room 8 排在前面。

title.en: Word error rate from a minimum alignment
title.zh: 由最小对齐求词错误率

prompt.en:
Mia checks a transcript against a reference.

Reference: put the red cup on the shelf
Prediction: put a red cup on shelf please

Find a minimum alignment, count substitutions S, deletions D and insertions I, and compute WER = (S + D + I) / N, where N is the number of reference words. Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Mia 把一份转写结果与参考文本进行核对。

参考：put the red cup on the shelf
预测：put a red cup on shelf please

找出一种最小对齐，数出替换 S、删除 D 和插入 I，并计算 WER = (S + D + I) / N，其中 N 是参考文本的词数。保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Align word by word:
put = put
the → a (substitution)
red = red, cup = cup, on = on
the → (missing) (deletion)
shelf = shelf
(nothing) → please (insertion)

S = 1, D = 1, I = 1. The reference has N = 7 words.
WER = (1 + 1 + 1) / 7 = 3 / 7 ≈ 0.429.

No alignment needs fewer than 3 edits, because the prediction has one wrong word, lacks one word and adds one word. Note that the denominator is the reference length (7), not the prediction length; with many insertions WER can exceed 1. A low WER also says nothing about who spoke or whether the meaning survived.
solution.zh:
逐词对齐：
put = put
the → a（替换）
red = red，cup = cup，on = on
the →（缺失）（删除）
shelf = shelf
（无）→ please（插入）

S = 1，D = 1，I = 1。参考文本有 N = 7 个词。
WER = (1 + 1 + 1) / 7 = 3 / 7 ≈ 0.429。

任何对齐都至少需要 3 次编辑，因为预测中有一个错词、少了一个词、多了一个词。注意分母是参考文本的长度（7），而不是预测的长度；插入很多时 WER 可以超过 1。WER 低也说明不了是谁在说话，或者意思是否保留了下来。

title.en: Who spoke when?
title.zh: 谁在什么时候说话？

prompt.en: Jack wants to know who spoke when in a recorded meeting. His speech-recognition transcript has a word error rate of 0.05. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: Jack 想知道一段会议录音中谁在什么时候说话。他的语音识别转写结果的词错误率是 0.05。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: He needs speaker diarization, which marks speaker turns in time. A low WER says how well the words were written, not who said them.
text.zh: 他需要说话人分离，它在时间轴上标出各个说话人的轮次。WER 低只说明词写得准不准，不说明是谁说的。

why.en: Right. Transcription and diarization are different tasks with different targets. Diarization gives anonymous labels such as speaker A and B, not verified names.
why.zh: 正确。转写和说话人分离是目标不同的两个任务。说话人分离给出的是 A、B 这样的匿名标签，而不是经过核实的姓名。

text.en: A WER of 0.05 means that 95% of the speaker labels are right.
text.zh: WER 为 0.05 意味着 95% 的说话人标签是对的。

why.en: Wrong. WER counts word substitutions, deletions and insertions. It contains no speaker information at all.
why.zh: 错误。WER 统计的是词的替换、删除和插入，其中根本不包含说话人的信息。

text.en: Translating the transcript into another language will reveal the speaker turns.
text.zh: 把转写结果翻译成另一种语言就能显示出说话人的轮次。

why.en: Wrong. Translation changes the language of the words; it does not add who-spoke-when information.
why.zh: 错误。翻译改变的是词的语言，不会增加「谁在何时说话」的信息。

text.en: Sound-event recognition will name each speaker, because each voice is a distinct sound event.
text.zh: 声音事件识别会说出每个说话人的名字，因为每个人的声音都是一个独立的声音事件。

why.en: Wrong. Sound-event recognition labels kinds of sounds, such as a door slam. It does not separate speaker turns or verify identities.
why.zh: 错误。声音事件识别标注的是声音的种类，例如关门声。它不会区分说话人的轮次，也不会核实身份。

title.en: Score audio shifts against video events
title.zh: 为音频相对视频的各个偏移打分

prompt.en:
Iris marks claps on a timeline of 8 steps, 0.04 seconds apart. 1 means an event at that step. For each shift she computes score(shift) = Σ visual[t] × audio[t + shift], using only indices valid in both lists. A positive shift means the audio event appears later than the visual one.

Fill in the visual steps t whose event meets an audio event (write the t values separated by single spaces, or none) and the score. The first row is done for you.
prompt.zh:
Iris 在一条由 8 个时间步组成的时间轴上标记拍手，每步间隔 0.04 秒。1 表示该时间步有事件。对每个偏移，她计算 score(shift) = Σ visual[t] × audio[t + shift]，只使用在两个列表中都有效的下标。正的偏移表示音频事件比视觉事件出现得晚。

请填写其事件与某个音频事件相遇的视觉时间步 t（多个 t 用单个空格隔开，没有则写 none），以及分数。第一行已经填好。

questions.code:
visual = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]
audio  = [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0]
for shift in [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3]:
    hits = [t for t in range(len(visual))
            if 0 <= t + shift < len(audio) and visual[t] * audio[t + shift]]
    print(shift, hits, len(hits))

zh: 匹配上的视觉时间步 t

solution.en:
Visual events are at t = 1 and 4; audio events are at 3 and 6.

Shift 0: audio[1] and audio[4] are both 0, so no match.
Shift 1: audio[2] and audio[5] are 0, so no match.
Shift 2: audio[3] = 1 and audio[6] = 1, so both claps match: score 2.
Shift 3: audio[4] and audio[7] are 0, so no match.
Shift −1 (given): visual t = 4 meets audio[3], a coincidence that matches one clap only.

The best shift is 2 steps, so the audio is late by 2 × 0.04 = 0.08 seconds; under this convention, move the audio 0.08 seconds earlier. Shift −1 shows why one matching event is weak evidence: with repeated claps, a wrong shift can still line up one pair. Checking a second, distinct event late in the clip would also reveal drift.
solution.zh:
视觉事件位于 t = 1 和 4；音频事件位于 3 和 6。

偏移 0：audio[1] 和 audio[4] 都是 0，没有匹配。
偏移 1：audio[2] 和 audio[5] 都是 0，没有匹配。
偏移 2：audio[3] = 1，audio[6] = 1，两次拍手都匹配上了：分数 2。
偏移 3：audio[4] 和 audio[7] 都是 0，没有匹配。
偏移 −1（已给出）：视觉 t = 4 遇上了 audio[3]，这是一个巧合，只匹配了一次拍手。

最佳偏移是 2 步，所以音频晚了 2 × 0.04 = 0.08 秒；按这个约定，应把音频提前 0.08 秒。偏移 −1 说明只有一个事件匹配是很弱的证据：拍手重复出现时，错误的偏移也可能对上一对。在片段末尾再检查一个不同的事件，还能发现时钟漂移。

questions.verify_code:
visual = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]
audio = [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0]
for shift in [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3]:
    hits = [t for t in range(len(visual)) if 0 <= t + shift < len(audio) and visual[t] * audio[t + shift]]
    print('\t'.join([str(shift), ' '.join(map(str, hits)) or 'none', str(len(hits))]))

title.en: Temporal IoU of a predicted interval
title.zh: 预测区间的时间交并比

prompt.en: The checked interval for "the cart turns" is [12, 20] seconds. Emma's model predicts [15, 25] seconds. What is the temporal IoU? Give 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 「小车转弯」的核对区间是 [12, 20] 秒。Emma 的模型预测为 [15, 25] 秒。时间交并比是多少？保留 3 位小数。

solution.en:
Intersection I = max(0, min(25, 20) − max(15, 12)) = 20 − 15 = 5 seconds.
Union U = (25 − 15) + (20 − 12) − 5 = 10 + 8 − 5 = 13 seconds.
tIoU = 5 / 13 ≈ 0.385.

The prediction starts 3 seconds late and ends 5 seconds late. tIoU measures boundary overlap only; it would be the same if the model had described a completely different action in that interval.
solution.zh:
交集 I = max(0, min(25, 20) − max(15, 12)) = 20 − 15 = 5 秒。
并集 U = (25 − 15) + (20 − 12) − 5 = 10 + 8 − 5 = 13 秒。
tIoU = 5 / 13 ≈ 0.385。

预测开始得晚了 3 秒，结束得晚了 5 秒。tIoU 只衡量边界的重叠；即使模型在这个区间里描述的是完全不同的动作，它的值也一样。

questions.verify_code:
p, g = (15, 25), (12, 20)
inter = max(0, min(p[1], g[1]) - max(p[0], g[0]))
union = (p[1] - p[0]) + (g[1] - g[0]) - inter
print(inter, union)
print(round(inter / union, 4))

title.en: A short event between sampled frames
title.zh: 落在采样帧之间的短暂事件

prompt.en: A 20-second video is sampled at timestamps 0, Δ, 2Δ, … (strictly before 20 s). A brief hand-over happens only from 7.4 s to 8.6 s. Leon compares Δ = 3 s with Δ = 2 s. Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: 一段 20 秒的视频按时间戳 0、Δ、2Δ……采样（严格早于 20 秒）。一次短暂的传递只发生在 7.4 秒到 8.6 秒之间。Leon 比较 Δ = 3 秒和 Δ = 2 秒。下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: With Δ = 3 s no sampled instant falls inside 7.4–8.6 s, so the model never sees the event; with Δ = 2 s the frame at 8 s does.
text.zh: Δ = 3 秒时，没有任何采样时刻落在 7.4–8.6 秒之内，模型根本看不到这个事件；Δ = 2 秒时，8 秒处的帧会落在其中。

why.en: Right. Δ = 3 gives 0, 3, 6, 9, …, which jumps from 6 to 9. Δ = 2 gives 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, …, and 8 lies inside the event.

text.en: With Δ = 3 s the frame at 9 s shows the event, because it is the nearest sample.
text.zh: Δ = 3 秒时，9 秒处的帧能显示这个事件，因为它是最近的采样。

why.en: Wrong. Nearest is not inside: at 9 s the hand-over has already ended (it stopped at 8.6 s).
why.zh: 错误。最近不等于在其中：到 9 秒时传递已经结束了（它在 8.6 秒结束）。

text.en: Averaging the features of the sampled frames recovers the missed event.
text.zh: 对采样帧的特征取平均，就能找回漏掉的事件。

why.en: Wrong. A model cannot use a frame it was never given. Averaging also throws away order.
why.zh: 错误。模型无法使用从未提供给它的帧。取平均还会丢掉顺序。

text.en: With Δ = 2 s the event is still missed, because 8 s is too close to the end of the event.
text.zh: Δ = 2 秒时仍会漏掉这个事件，因为 8 秒离事件结束太近了。

why.en: Wrong. 7.4 ≤ 8 ≤ 8.6, so the frame at 8 s is inside the event, which is what matters.
why.zh: 错误。7.4 ≤ 8 ≤ 8.6，所以 8 秒处的帧在事件之内，这才是关键。

title.en: What changes in each training stage
title.zh: 每个训练阶段改变了什么

prompt.en: Which description matches the guide's account of the original LLaVA recipe?
prompt.zh: 下列哪项描述与本指南对原始 LLaVA 训练方法的介绍一致？

text.en: Stage 1 trains only the projection connector. Stage 2 (instruction tuning) updates the connector and the language model, while the vision encoder stays frozen.
text.zh: 第 1 阶段只训练投影连接器。第 2 阶段（指令微调）更新连接器和语言模型，而视觉编码器保持冻结。

why.en: Right. The vision encoder is never updated in this recipe; the connector is trained first, then the connector and language model learn from image–request–response examples.
why.zh: 正确。在这种方法中视觉编码器从不更新；先训练连接器，然后连接器和语言模型一起从「图像–请求–回答」样本中学习。

text.en: Both stages update the vision encoder, because instruction tuning must improve perception.
text.zh: 两个阶段都更新视觉编码器，因为指令微调必须提升感知能力。

why.en: Wrong. In the original recipe the vision encoder stays frozen throughout. Instruction tuning teaches response behaviour; it does not by itself fix perception.
why.zh: 错误。在原始方法中，视觉编码器自始至终保持冻结。指令微调教的是回答方式，它本身并不能修正感知。

text.en: A small Q-Former learns to query a frozen image encoder and connect it to a frozen language model.
text.zh: 一个小型 Q-Former 学习查询冻结的图像编码器，并把它连接到冻结的语言模型。

why.en: Wrong. That describes BLIP-2's pretraining recipe, a different historical design.
why.zh: 错误。那描述的是 BLIP-2 的预训练方法，是另一种历史上的设计。

text.en: Only the language model is trained; no connector is needed because image features are already text.
text.zh: 只训练语言模型；不需要连接器，因为图像特征本来就是文本。

why.en: Wrong. Image features and text features are different numerical formats; the connector translates between them.
why.zh: 错误。图像特征和文本特征是不同的数值格式；连接器负责在两者之间转换。

title.en: Design a multimodal RAG helper
title.zh: 设计一个多模态 RAG 助手

prompt.en:
Emma builds a question-answering helper over 300 workshop manuals. Each manual is a set of pages with text and diagrams, and some manuals exist in two versions. Users ask questions such as "Which way should the filter arrow point?", where the answer is often shown only in a diagram.

Describe (a) what to store for each searchable chunk, (b) the steps from question to answer, including what happens when evidence is missing or conflicting, (c) how to evaluate the system stage by stage, and (d) one rule about how retrieved text is treated.
prompt.zh:
Emma 要为 300 本车间手册构建一个问答助手。每本手册由若干页组成，包含文字和示意图，有些手册还有两个版本。用户会问诸如「滤芯上的箭头应该朝哪个方向？」这样的问题，而答案往往只在示意图中给出。

请说明：(a) 每个可检索的内容块要存储什么；(b) 从问题到答案的步骤，包括证据缺失或相互矛盾时怎么办；(c) 如何分阶段评估这个系统；(d) 一条关于如何对待检索到的文字的规则。

solution.en:
(a) Chunks: text passages and diagram regions (image crops) stored separately, each with a source ID, manual version and date, page number and region box, plus the embedding and the encoder version used to make it.

(b) Steps: retrieve candidates by text and image embeddings, then check that each candidate is relevant to the question (right model, right version). Read the specific diagram region. Answer only what the evidence supports and cite the source ID, page and region. If no checked evidence is found, say so instead of guessing; if two versions disagree, report the conflict or use the version that applies, stated explicitly.

(c) Evaluation on a set of checked questions, stage by stage: retrieval recall@k (is the needed page or region in the shortlist?); reading accuracy (was the diagram read correctly?); support (does the cited region support the claim?); end-to-end answer accuracy; and correct abstention on questions whose evidence is absent. Separate scores show where a failure happens.

(d) Retrieved text is source material, not instructions: a page that says "ignore your rules" must not change the helper's behaviour.
solution.zh:
(a) 内容块：文字段落和示意图区域（图像裁剪）分别存储，每块都带有来源 ID、手册版本和日期、页码和区域框，以及嵌入向量和生成它所用的编码器版本。

(b) 步骤：用文字和图像嵌入检索候选，然后检查每个候选是否与问题相关（型号对不对、版本对不对）。读取具体的示意图区域。只回答证据所支持的内容，并引用来源 ID、页码和区域。如果找不到经核对的证据，就如实说明而不是猜测；如果两个版本相互矛盾，就报告这一矛盾，或者明确说明采用了哪个适用的版本。

(c) 在一组核对过的问题上分阶段评估：检索的 recall@k（需要的页面或区域是否在候选名单中？）；读取准确率（示意图读得对不对？）；支持度（引用的区域是否支持该说法？）；端到端的回答准确率；以及在证据缺失的问题上是否正确拒答。分开的分数能显示失败发生在哪个环节。

(d) 检索到的文字是来源材料，而不是指令：某一页上写着「忽略你的规则」，也不能改变助手的行为。

text.en: Stores chunks (text and diagram regions) with source ID, page or region, and version.
text.zh: 存储内容块（文字和示意图区域），并带有来源 ID、页码或区域，以及版本。

text.en: Retrieves candidates, then checks relevance before reading and answering.
text.zh: 先检索候选，再在读取和回答之前检查相关性。

text.en: Answers only what the evidence supports and cites the source ID, page and region.
text.zh: 只回答证据所支持的内容，并引用来源 ID、页码和区域。

text.en: States a policy for missing or conflicting evidence (abstain, or report the conflict and the version used).
text.zh: 制定证据缺失或矛盾时的策略（拒答，或报告矛盾以及所用的版本）。

text.en: Evaluates retrieval (for example recall@k) separately from reading, support and final answers.
text.zh: 把检索（例如 recall@k）与读取、支持度和最终答案分开评估。

text.en: Treats retrieved text as data, not as instructions that can change the system's behaviour.
text.zh: 把检索到的文字当作数据，而不是能改变系统行为的指令。

mistakes.en: Measuring only final-answer accuracy, so a retrieval failure looks like a reading failure.
mistakes.zh: 只测量最终答案的准确率，导致检索失败看起来像读取失败。

mistakes.en: Citing any page that mentions the right words, instead of the region that shows the answer.
mistakes.zh: 随便引用一个出现了相关词语的页面，而不是给出答案的那个区域。

mistakes.en: Letting the generator fill a plausible direction when no diagram was retrieved.
mistakes.zh: 在没有检索到示意图时，让生成器填上一个看似合理的方向。

title.en: Fewer hallucinations, less coverage
title.zh: 幻觉更少，覆盖率也更低

prompt.en:
Noah audits two caption sets for the same 20 photos, which contain 80 annotated target objects in total.

Set X: 50 object mentions, 5 unsupported, found in 4 captions; the other 45 mentions are distinct correct targets.
Set Y: 20 object mentions, 1 unsupported, in 1 caption; the other 19 are distinct correct targets.

Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh:
Noah 审核同一组 20 张照片的两套图像描述，这些照片共有 80 个标注的目标物体。

X 组：50 次物体提及，其中 5 次没有依据，分布在 4 条描述中；其余 45 次提及是互不重复的正确目标。
Y 组：20 次物体提及，其中 1 次没有依据，在 1 条描述中；其余 19 次是互不重复的正确目标。

下列哪项说法正确？

text.en: Y has the lower instance-level CHAIR (0.05 against 0.10) but much lower coverage (0.24 against 0.56). Neither set is better on every measure.
text.zh: Y 的实例级 CHAIR 更低（0.05 对 0.10），但覆盖率也低得多（0.24 对 0.56）。没有哪一组在所有指标上都更好。

why.en: Right. CHAIRᵢ: X 5/50 = 0.10, Y 1/20 = 0.05. Coverage: X 45/80 ≈ 0.56, Y 19/80 ≈ 0.24. Saying less avoids errors but also omits useful facts.
why.zh: 正确。CHAIRᵢ：X 为 5/50 = 0.10，Y 为 1/20 = 0.05。覆盖率：X 为 45/80 ≈ 0.56，Y 为 19/80 ≈ 0.24。说得少能避免错误，但也漏掉了有用的事实。

text.en: Y is better on every measure, because it invents fewer objects.
text.zh: Y 在每个指标上都更好，因为它编造的物体更少。

why.en: Wrong. Y's coverage is far lower: it mentions only 19 of the 80 target objects.
why.zh: 错误。Y 的覆盖率低得多：80 个目标物体中它只提到了 19 个。

text.en: X's sentence-level CHAIR is 5/20 = 0.25.
text.zh: X 的句子级 CHAIR 是 5/20 = 0.25。

why.en: Wrong. Sentence level counts captions with at least one error: 4 of 20, so 0.20. The 5 is a count of mentions.
why.zh: 错误。句子级统计的是至少含一个错误的描述条数：20 条中有 4 条，所以是 0.20。5 是提及的次数。

text.en: X has the lower instance-level CHAIR, because it mentions more correct objects.
text.zh: X 的实例级 CHAIR 更低，因为它提到的正确物体更多。

why.en: Wrong. CHAIRᵢ is the unsupported share of mentions: 0.10 for X is higher than 0.05 for Y. More correct mentions raise coverage, not this score.
why.zh: 错误。CHAIRᵢ 是无依据提及所占的比例：X 的 0.10 高于 Y 的 0.05。正确提及多会提高覆盖率，而不是降低这个分数。

questions.verify_code:
for name, m, h, cap, correct in [('X', 50, 5, 4, 45), ('Y', 20, 1, 1, 19)]:
    print(name, h / m, cap / 20, round(correct / 80, 4))

title.en: Sentence-level CHAIR
title.zh: 句子级 CHAIR

prompt.en:
Iris reviews 12 captions. Together they contain 48 counted object mentions, of which 9 are unsupported by the photos. The 9 unsupported mentions are spread over 5 different captions. The photos contain 60 annotated target objects, and the 39 supported mentions are all distinct targets.

What is the sentence-level CHAIRₛ? Give 3 decimal places. (Also work out CHAIRᵢ and coverage.)
prompt.zh:
Iris 审核了 12 条图像描述。它们一共包含 48 次被计数的物体提及，其中 9 次在照片中没有依据。这 9 次无依据提及分布在 5 条不同的描述中。照片共有 60 个标注的目标物体，39 次有依据的提及都是互不重复的目标。

句子级 CHAIRₛ 是多少？保留 3 位小数。（同时算出 CHAIRᵢ 和覆盖率。）

solution.en:
Sentence level: captions with at least one unsupported mention / all captions = 5 / 12 ≈ 0.417.

Instance level: unsupported mentions / all mentions = 9 / 48 = 0.1875.

Coverage: correctly mentioned distinct targets / all targets = 39 / 60 = 0.65.

The three numbers answer different questions: how often a caption contains any invention (42% of captions), how many mentions are invented (about 19%), and how much of what is really there gets mentioned (65%). Using 9 / 12 = 0.75 for the sentence level is the usual slip: it counts mentions, not captions.
solution.zh:
句子级：至少含一次无依据提及的描述数 / 全部描述数 = 5 / 12 ≈ 0.417。

实例级：无依据提及数 / 全部提及数 = 9 / 48 = 0.1875。

覆盖率：被正确提及的不重复目标数 / 全部目标数 = 39 / 60 = 0.65。

三个数字回答的是不同的问题：一条描述含有编造内容的频率（42% 的描述），被编造的提及有多少（约 19%），以及真实存在的东西被提到了多少（65%）。常见错误是用 9 / 12 = 0.75 作为句子级分数：那是在数提及，而不是数描述。

questions.verify_code:
captions, mentions, unsupported, with_error, targets = 12, 48, 9, 5, 60
print(unsupported / mentions, (mentions - unsupported) / targets)
print(round(with_error / captions, 4))

title.en: Toy cost saving of a two-stage cascade
title.zh: 两阶段级联的玩具成本节省

prompt.en:
Jack's archive helper has N = 400 candidate pages. A cheap retrieval pass costs 0.5 units per page; the detailed reader costs 8 units per page. The cascade runs the cheap pass on every page and the detailed reader on the top k = 20 only.

Using full_cost = N × expensive_cost and cascade_cost = N × cheap_cost + k × expensive_cost, what fraction of the toy cost does the cascade save? Give 4 decimal places.
prompt.zh:
Jack 的档案助手有 N = 400 个候选页面。便宜的检索阶段每页花费 0.5 个单位；精细阅读器每页花费 8 个单位。级联对每一页都运行便宜阶段，但只对前 k = 20 页运行精细阅读器。

使用 full_cost = N × expensive_cost 和 cascade_cost = N × cheap_cost + k × expensive_cost，级联节省了多大比例的玩具成本？保留 4 位小数。

solution.en:
Full cost: 400 × 8 = 3200 units.
Cascade cost: 400 × 0.5 + 20 × 8 = 200 + 160 = 360 units.
Saved fraction = 1 − 360 / 3200 = 1 − 0.1125 = 0.8875.

So the cascade does 88.75% less toy work. That saving is worth having only if the shortlist keeps the evidence: if the page a question needs is ranked 25th by the cheap pass, the detailed reader never sees it and the answer must fail or abstain. Measure retrieval recall at k = 20 on checked questions before trusting the speed-up, and remember that this arithmetic ignores overheads and parallel hardware.
solution.zh:
完整成本：400 × 8 = 3200 个单位。
级联成本：400 × 0.5 + 20 × 8 = 200 + 160 = 360 个单位。
节省比例 = 1 − 360 / 3200 = 1 − 0.1125 = 0.8875。

所以级联少做了 88.75% 的玩具工作量。只有当候选名单保留了证据时，这种节省才有价值：如果某个问题需要的页面在便宜阶段排在第 25 名，精细阅读器就永远看不到它，回答只能失败或拒答。在信任这种加速之前，要在核对过的问题上测量 k = 20 时的检索召回率；还要记住，这个算式忽略了额外开销和并行硬件。

questions.verify_code:
N, cheap, expensive, k = 400, 0.5, 8, 20
full = N * expensive
cascade = N * cheap + k * expensive
print(full, cascade)
print(round(1 - cascade / full, 6))

title.en: Diagnostic: four stages in 20 minutes
title.zh: 诊断卷：用 20 分钟检查四个阶段

note.en:
An original 20-minute check across the four stages of this guide: numbers, meaning and evidence; comparing, mixing and generating; documents, speech and video; and adapting, retrieving and verifying. It is practice written for this site and is not a guide to the format or content of any real exam.

Marks: 20. Every question marks itself. Afterwards, see which stage lost marks and go back to those chapters.

Use pen, paper and a basic calculator (square root, exp and ln). Keep at least 4 decimals in the middle of a calculation and round only at the end; the stated tolerance covers that rounding. Python is for checking your work afterwards, not for the paper.
note.zh:
这是一份原创的 20 分钟检查卷，覆盖本指南的四个阶段：数字、含义与证据；比较、混合与生成；文档、语音与视频；适配、检索与核查。它是为本站编写的练习，不是任何真实考试的格式或内容指南。

总分：20 分。每道题都会自动评分。做完后看看哪个阶段丢分最多，再回到对应的章节复习。

用笔、纸和一个基础计算器作答（需要平方根、exp 和 ln）。计算过程中至少保留 4 位小数，只在最后一步取舍；题目给出的容差已经包含这种舍入。Python 只用来事后检查，不在答卷时使用。
